recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#E8E8E8). 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#A02C3A) rectangular outline inset about 5% from all slide edges, no fill. 3. Draw a centered white-filled rectangle (#FFFFFF) with a thin dark-red (#A02C3A) outline, spanning roughly 17%-80% of slide width and 32%-66% of height. 4. Inside that rectangle, place the text 'Data Sets' in a large bold sans-serif font, colored red (#B01E28), centered horizontally and vertically. 5. In the top-right corner, draw a small yellow (#F5E97A) circle with a dark outline and place the number '23' in small dark text inside it. 6. (Optional) Add a tiny faint gray squiggle near the top-center (~54% width, ~24% height) to match the artifact.
